slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-93 ACI textColor
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with two root-reachable MLEADERSTYLE records. STANDARD has one existing group-93 INTEGER ACI value 0 and an opaque group-302 tag; group 91 is 0, group 90 is 0 and group 92 is 25. SECONDARY is unchanged. Supports a standalone typed textColor change from 0 to 7 only when no group 420-449 CMC extension appears in the style body.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain one existing group-93 INTEGER corresponding to parsed textColor. The edited value must be within the library's validated ACI range 0..256. No group 420-449 may occur in the AcDbMLeaderStyle body. textColor must be the only changed typed payload field; leaderColor, maxLeaderPoints, leaderLineWeight, table-entry identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and every other encoded style field must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-93 value in a copy of the captured raw body using the ordinary INTEGER variant. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 93, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits including another color field, CMC extension groups 420-449, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction. Truecolor, color-name and transparency forms remain refused.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect staged OBJECTS output against retained raw fields and mapped handles, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require textColor to equal 7 while unchanged leaderColor remains 0, maxLeaderPoints remains 0 and leaderLineWeight remains 25. Fresh readback checks typed values and exactly one literal group-93 INTEGER value 7. Both source encodings are exercised; output uses same-format and cross-format ASCII/binary paths.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 93 from 0 to 1 while typed textColor requests 7 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. A simultaneous group-91 leaderColor edit refuses atomically. A late typed textColor mutation after preflight refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the requested value permits same-adapter retry. An authored source containing group 420 truecolor metadata after group 93 refuses the edit and preserves the destination. Exact output and fresh-readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions, multiple changes on one record, or extended CMC color forms. Typed DWG-origin writing remains unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 93=0 after group 91=0 and group 92=25. Its optional text-color guard source adds group 420=0x654321 after group 93. ASCII and binary inputs are generated locally from scratch.

It does not prove independent producer variation, native text color appearance, truecolor/color-book/transparency rewriting, cross-version support, DWG editing, block-content color edits, consumer acceptance or full document closure.
No support claim is promoted; the support ledger remains closed.
